title: I made a FREE tool that turns text or video into 3d avatar animations, with IK controls for adjustments
author: Tonydarko1
selftext:
I’m a technical artist, and I’ve been building a simpler way to create avatar animations without needing animation experience.

You describe a movement or upload a reference video, generate the animation, preview it on an avatar, and adjust the pose with IK controls before exporting a GLB.

Text prompts drive motion generation, while video input uses body tracking that you can review and correct before generating. The pipeline also includes motion cleanup to reduce noise. I’m keeping the editing simple for now, with pose adjustments rather than a full keyframe editor.

This first version uses Decentraland’s avatar rig, which is similar to Mixamo’s humanoid setup. Other rigs aren’t supported directly yet, but you can import the GLB into Blender and retarget it, with some bone mapping and pose corrections where needed.

It’s designed to run locally on a CPU or a GPU with 4 GB of VRAM. I’ve also put up a free, no-registration hosted demo during the beta so people can try it without setting anything up.

I’m still working on improving the animation quality, and I’d like to explore support for more rigs

Curious what you think
